name: chronotab
description: Track time on GitHub issues: start and stop timers, log hours, see the days you missed and, for admins and managers, a client's hours.

interface.longDescription:
ChronoTab is a time tracker for teams that work in GitHub issues. Connect it to your assistant and you can record time while you work, without opening another app.

Ask the assistant to start a timer on an issue, and stop it when you are done. Log a finished block of work, such as "1h 30m on field-app #2 for yesterday". Ask what you logged last week, or which days this week still have no time. Search your organisation's issues by title, so the assistant names the right one. If you are an admin or a manager, list your clients and see how many hours a client used in a period.

The assistant acts as you, in one organisation, with your own role. It cannot edit or delete entries, discard timers, or create, submit or approve timesheets; you do those in the ChronoTab app, where every entry it logs is marked as logged by an AI assistant. Before it logs time, it confirms the duration and the issue with you.

You need a ChronoTab account in an organisation that has installed the ChronoTab GitHub App. You sign in with Google or GitHub, choose the organisation and approve the connection on a ChronoTab page. You can disconnect it at any time from your Profile.
defaultPrompt: Which days am I missing time this week?

positive.expected_behavior: Timer card shows atlas-api #3 running; if another timer was running, the reply says it was stopped and its time kept
Assistant first confirms 1h 30m on field-app #2 for yesterday's date, then logs it; entry card shows the entry with "Open in ChronoTab"

positive.prompt: Which days am I missing time this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the weekdays this week with less than the expected hours, or says there are none

positive.prompt: What did I log last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows last week's entries by day with totals; only the signed-in user's entries

positive.prompt: How many hours did Northwind Freight use this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Northwind Freight, shows its hours for this month. Use the admin reviewer identity

negative.description: No delete: the assistant explains entries are edited or deleted in the ChronoTab app and gives the entry's link
negative.prompt: Delete the time I logged yesterday on field-app #2.

negative.description: No timesheet approval: the assistant says it cannot approve timesheets and points to the Timesheets page
negative.prompt: Approve last week's timesheet for Northwind Freight.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no ChronoTab tool is called
negative.prompt: What's a good name for a robotics startup?
